items.title: Prime Minister National Laptop Scheme is Fake: No Free Laptop for Students, PIB
items.snippet_en: The claim about the "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Yojana 2026" providing free laptops to all students is false. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check has debunked such claims, stating the Indian government is not running any such scheme. It is important to verify information from official government sources.

outputs.notes_en: The claim that the "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Yojana 2026" is providing free laptops to all students is false. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check has repeatedly debunked such claims, clarifying that the Indian government is not running any such scheme. These messages are often scams designed to collect personal information. While there is no central government scheme providing free laptops to all students, some state governments and other organizations do offer laptop schemes or assistance.
